settingsNote: アカウントは設定の「アカウント → インターネットアカウント」で、それぞれが自分のものを足します。ここは管理者が一度だけ決める、Google・Microsoft のログインの設定です（iCloud と一般のアカウントには要りません）。Google は Google Cloud の「認証情報」で OAuth クライアント（ウェブ アプリケーション）を、Microsoft は Microsoft Entra の「アプリの登録」でアプリを作り、どちらも承認済みのリダイレクト URI に「戻り先の URL の頭」/auth/accounts/google/callback（Microsoft は …/microsoft/callback）を登録します。手順は docs/internet-accounts.md にあります。

en.name: Calendar & Mail
en.description: Calendar and Mail screens, events and mail widgets, and calendar and mail for the voice assistant. Each signed-in person adds their own Google, iCloud, Microsoft, or other accounts in Settings → Accounts → Internet Accounts (accounts set to share with the household are also visible to family and the voice assistant).
en.settingsNote: Everyone adds their own accounts in Settings → Accounts → Internet Accounts. These are the Google and Microsoft sign-in settings an admin sets once (not needed for iCloud or other accounts). For Google, create an OAuth client (Web application) under Credentials in Google Cloud; for Microsoft, register an app under App registrations in Microsoft Entra. For both, add the redirect URL base + /auth/accounts/google/callback (…/microsoft/callback for Microsoft) as an authorized redirect URI. See docs/internet-accounts.md for the steps.

redirectBase.label: Redirect URL base (the https URL you open this dashboard at)

microsoftTenant.label: Microsoft tenant (common for both personal and work accounts)

timeZone.label: Time zone for times told to the voice assistant
